content.value: The table offers supported crafting recipes up to the vanilla 3 x 3 size, including [[article/hand_crafting|Hand Crafting]] recipes. Select a recipe instead of arranging ingredients in a shaped grid.
Materials are drawn from the hotbar, regular inventory and unlocked bag storage. Type a batch quantity and check the total output before crafting.

Every required ingredient must have a discovered alternative before the recipe appears. Craftable checks what you have now; discovery remembers what you have obtained before. Recipe discovery is individual to each player.

Building parts are made at the [[article/cutting_bench|Cutting Bench]]. Advanced equipment belongs to the [[article/anvil|Anvil]], ranged equipment and arrows to the [[article/fletching|Fletching Table]], and textile work to the [[article/tailoring|Tailoring Bench]]. The table keeps ordinary assembly and its supported recycling operations.

Non-meltable equipment can be recycled through its supported table operation. Metal salvage belongs to the [[article/foundry|Foundry]]. Destructive operations show their result and any confirmation required by the current station.
